$comment: Reviewed short source excerpts, at most 25 words per source page, for optional saint/feast descriptions. Original prose and underlying source credits are retained; excerpts are not first-party prayer text or machine translations. Explicit 2026/2027 date plus exact title/identity joins are mandatory, never coincident date, title normalization or array position. Source edition UUIDs differ across languages. Missing Hebrew, Russian, Filipino and Ukrainian prose stays absent; no language fallback or borrowing from the Hebrew Syriac Urtotho source. Provider metadata retains source date/title/UUID and the original HTML digest for verification. Adding coverage requires reviewing the exact source subject and source-language excerpt.
